name: site-studio
description: Reusable tools, patterns and templates for your own portfolio, resume or link-hub site (one page of your links) on GitHub Pages; you and your session shape its look. Needs a Mac or Linux computer (not Windows) and a GitHub account with gh. Only the built site goes public, when you type /site-studio:publish and approve a dry run. Start a site, add work, keep your resume and PDF current, preview, and review privacy and quality. Not for job applications, outreach or tracking a search (jobsearch).

metadata.versioningPolicy: Explicit releases; version reflects the release group's largest change (minor/patch). Bump before any sync or push — an unbumped change ships nothing and looks like a broken install.
metadata.provides: 6 agents, 12 skills (setup, adopt, publish user-only; coordinator also answers help: what you can do, what next, what an error means), hooks/hooks.json (SessionStart doctor+sync_main; PreToolUse publish_guard). Data: the person's dev repo, site/site.json schema 1 to 7, a look layered over the derived one (site/looks/local.json). Contracts: spec/roster.json, docs/plugin-agent-contract.md
